description: A blank panel whose colour is set by three CV inputs, read either as red, green and blue or as hue, saturation and lightness

inputs.text: Sets the red of the panel colour in RGB mode, or its hue in HSL mode, over the range chosen in the Input Range menu
Sets the green of the panel colour in RGB mode, or its saturation in HSL mode, over the range chosen in the Input Range menu
Sets the blue of the panel colour in RGB mode, or its lightness in HSL mode, over the range chosen in the Input Range menu

notes: the module comes up on -5 - +5V (bi) and on HSL, so a 0-10V modulation source reaches only the top half of each range until Input Range is changed
dragging either edge of the module makes it wider or narrower, down to a minimum of 6HP
an unpatched input holds its part of the colour at a fixed starting value, which is why the module opens violet
menu: ColorMode — a heading over RGB and HSL, choosing whether the three inputs are read as red, green and blue or as hue, saturation and lightness; it comes up on HSL
Input Range — a heading over 0 - +10V (uni) and -5 - +5V (bi), setting the range all three inputs are read over; voltage beyond it is clamped
